transitions.historical_text: When this card is successfully Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned, put 1 Spell Counter on a face-up card on the field that you can put a Spell Counter on. If this card is destroyed as a result of battle, you can select 1 Spellcaster-Type monster Level 2 or lower from your deck and Special Summon it on the field in face-down Defense Position.
transitions.summary: Two era behaviours the printed text does not show, grouped because they share the same unknown chronology. (1) Trigger timing: the goat script registers the revival effect on EVENT_BATTLED with condition Card.IsBattleDestroyed() instead of the modern EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYED - upstream annotates the variant 'Triggers on the field' - so it activates while Apprentice Magician still occupies its Monster Zone, which means the free-zone test and the face-down Special Summon must find a zone other than its own. (2) Activation condition: the goat target function keeps only Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0, dropping the modern Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...) check, so the effect can be activated with no Level 2 or lower Spellcaster left in the Deck. Neither has a dated source, so the chronology stays unresolved.

effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

transitions.summary: Period procedure: on a failed Deck search the goat script calls Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK), revealing and shuffling the Deck to prove no Level 2 or lower Spellcaster remained; the modern script has no else-branch and reveals nothing. The printed text is untouched by this.

review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v1 (DR1-EN121, 2005-03-19), matched exactly by the goat cdb text; v0 (MFC-066, 2003-10-10, 'destroyed in battle') predates it. Lineage v1 -> v8 is collapsed as cosmetic: 'successfully Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned' -> 'Summoned', 'as a result of battle' -> 'by battle', and the PSCT target/place rewording. The 'Target' wording added at v5 (BATT-EN002, 2012-05-29) formalises existing targeting rather than introducing it - the counter effect carries EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET and Duel.SelectTarget in BOTH scripts, unchanged in the diff. One nuance left unrecorded: v8 (SBC1-ENA09, 2023-08-24) changes 'If this card is destroyed by battle:' to 'When ...:', a PSCT miss-timing distinction, but upstream ships a single modern script covering v5-v8, so there is no implementation difference to record and no bearing on the 2005/2010 snapshots. Change order: the undated pair is listed before (A) because the only dated per-card precedent for a withdrawn fail-to-find allowance (Reinforcement of the Army, gone by the 2008-12-15 Card FAQ) falls before (A)'s earliest possible end date (2011-02-02); the true order is unknown. No upstream implementation exists for the intermediate state and it is unreachable while the chronology is unresolved, so no missing-implementation record is attached. The last diff item, CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON+CATEGORY_SET -> CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON, is operation-info hinting, not behaviour.
